dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Low to moderate prominence; visible thin pale-grey margins on folded flight feathers against darker grey centers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: Small, rectangular rufous/reddish-brown patch visible on the posterior crown/nape area.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Indistinct; uniform grey coloration extends from the lower crown onto the mantle with no sharp linear transition.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent transverse banding on the tail consisting of alternating high-contrast black and white/pale grey bars.
